title: Empty, at rest
direction: Warm symbol + humanist word: a hand-thrown lipped bowl, emptied and set down, and a lowercase macnull in Fraunces whose stems all land on the same soft foot.
rationale: Null as a vessel emptied with care: a lipped bowl pours out deliberately, never smashes. Celadon-teal glaze on warm ink and paper gives calm craft rather than clinical tooling; teal also keeps clear of the amber the app uses for Check First warnings.

pitch.idea: A hand-thrown lipped bowl, emptied and set down: null as a vessel you pour out with care, not one you smash.
strengths: An object with character, not a UI icon: the spout makes a common bowl specific, and the empty interior is a real hole, so whatever is behind it shows through
Warm and calm in a category of brooms, sparkles and purple gradients
The word is visibly drawn: every stem in macnull, including the a, lands on the same soft pebble foot, and the second l rests a step lower, so the ll reads as a deliberate pair
Celadon teal keeps clear of the amber the app uses for Check First warnings
weaknesses: A bowl is still a kitchen object: some will read food, a gravy boat or a soup app before they read null
The spout could be read as a speech-bubble tail when the bowl is small
Fraunces 600 is wide, so the word needs room in a narrow toolbar
The lower second l is subtle and may look like an accident until it is explained
